news.headline: Abivax Presents Business Updates and First Half 2026 Financial Results
news.summary: Abivax reported cash, cash equivalents and short-term investments of €402.4 million at June 30, 2026, which combined with the €767.1 million in net proceeds from its July ADS offering gives a projected cash runway into Q4 2029; H1 net loss widened to €165.9 million on R&D spend of €107.9 million. The company reaffirmed it remains on track to submit the obefazimod NDA to the FDA for ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026, and announced that CMO Fabio Cataldi will depart in Q4 2026 to be succeeded by Chris Rabbat, alongside the appointment of Tim Kelly as new Chief Technical Officer.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley Raises Abivax Price Target to $101, Maintains Overweight Rating
news.summary: Morgan Stanley lifted its price target on Abivax's U.S.-listed ADS from $71 to $101 while keeping an Overweight rating, citing growing confidence in obefazimod's competitive profile in ulcerative colitis ahead of the planned FDA filing. The move added to an already unanimously bullish sell-side stance on the stock.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs Initiates Coverage on Abivax With Buy Rating, $155 Price Target
news.summary: Goldman Sachs analyst Rajan Sharma started coverage of Abivax with a Buy rating and a $155 price target, calling obefazimod's Phase 3 ABTECT efficacy and maintenance data "biologic-like" in an oral pill and modeling peak sales of roughly €4 billion in ulcerative colitis. The initiation extended an already unanimous Buy-side analyst consensus on the stock (11 Buys, zero Hold/Sell prior to Goldman's addition).

news.headline: The Drugmaker Abivax Has Still Not Been Acquired. What's Going On?
news.source: STAT News (Adam's Biotech Scorecard, Adam Feuerstein)
news.summary: Nine months after speculation first pegged a roughly $20 billion buyout of Abivax as imminent, STAT News noted the deal still had not materialized despite red-hot biotech M&A activity, with no clear public visibility into whether talks with Big Pharma suitors are ongoing. The piece frames Abivax's continued independence as a source of growing investor frustration even as obefazimod's commercial potential remains widely viewed as attractive to acquirers.

news.headline: 3 Takeover Targets in Immunology: Spyre, Abivax, MoonLake
news.summary: PharmaVoice named Abivax among three immunology names seen as prime acquisition candidates amid a wave of autoimmune-space dealmaking, recapping earlier-2026 rumors that Eli Lilly was interested in buying the company. Abivax CEO Marc de Garidel has publicly dismissed such takeover chatter as "noise" while the company continues building out its own U.S. commercial infrastructure.

catalysts.label: Obefazimod NDA submission to FDA (ulcerative colitis)
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA FDA interaction (July 30, 2026), Abivax reaffirmed at its Sept 21, 2026 H1 report that it remains on track to submit the NDA for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction readout (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction data from the ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b trial of obefazimod in Crohn's disease is now guided for mid-2027, a delay from earlier company commentary that had pointed to late 2026.

catalysts.label: CMO transition to Chris Rabbat
catalysts.detail: Current Chief Medical Officer Fabio Cataldi will depart in Q4 2026 and be succeeded by Chris Rabbat, alongside newly appointed CTO Tim Kelly, as the company builds out commercial/CMC leadership ahead of a potential launch.

catalysts.label: Potential acquisition by Big Pharma (Eli Lilly / AstraZeneca)
catalysts.detail: Recurring 2026 media reports have linked Abivax to takeover interest from Eli Lilly (~€15bn, January 2026) and AstraZeneca (March 2026); both companies and Abivax have declined to confirm or have denied talks, and as of September 2026 no deal has materialized, with management emphasizing a standalone U.S. launch strategy instead.

pulse: Abivax's Sept 21, 2026 H1 report showed a well-funded balance sheet (cash runway into Q4 2029 after the $920M July offering) alongside a widening net loss, and confirmed the obefazimod NDA for ulcerative colitis remains on track for filing by end-2026, even as the Crohn's-disease ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b readout slipped to mid-2027 and CMO Fabio Cataldi prepares to hand off to Chris Rabbat. Sell-side sentiment strengthened further in September with Goldman Sachs initiating at Buy ($155 PT) and Morgan Stanley lifting its target to $101, keeping the stock's analyst base unanimously bullish. The long-running Eli Lilly/AstraZeneca takeover speculation that dominated the stock's narrative earlier in 2026 remains unresolved and unconfirmed nine months on, per STAT News, with management instead doubling down on plans for an independent U.S. commercial launch.
